defects: Conclusion is wrong: produced statement concludes a = b (equality of the cardinals themselves) instead of a.toNat = b.toNat (equality of their natural-number truncations) as in the gold and informal statement

This makes the produced statement mathematically false in general: e.g. a = ℵ₀, b = ℵ₁ satisfies the hypothesis (both sides of the iff are true for all n since both cardinals are infinite) but a ≠ b, even though toNat a = toNat b = 0 as the informal statement asserts
Drops universe polymorphism: gold has c : Cardinal.{u}, d : Cardinal.{v} (possibly different universes), while produced statement uses a single Cardinal type for both a and b
